a: Use STRIDE per component during threat modeling sessions.
Abuse cases for login include credential stuffing and MFA fatigue.
Lockouts can enable denial of service; prefer soft delays.
Rotate session identifiers after privilege changes.
SameSite cookies reduce CSRF risk for many flows.
Encode output for the correct context (HTML, JS, URL).
Parameterized queries are the primary SQLi defense.
Practice key rotation so emergencies are routine.
Update dependencies regularly and review changelogs.
